==Biography==

== Trivia ==
* Nicknamed "Big Bro" in China.
* His real name '''高地平''' can mean "Base cleared" in ''League of Legends''.
* His favorite champion is {{ci|Rumble}}.
* Considered to be the best {{ci|Renekton}} player in China. In his LPL career life, he had picked Renekton 20 times and won 19 games with a KDA of 11.55. He is the player has the highest win rate of one champion in LPL  (stats provided in April 2017).
* Was featured in Riot's 2014 Worlds promotion video 'Road to Worlds'.<ref>[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Q8AnjrGRmAQ Road to Worlds: The Next Level]www.youtube.com</ref>
* Introduced to the LPL Hall of Fame in December 2022.
